book.name: MATEO
book.title: QꞌU BꞌAꞌNLA CHAJ CHUSBꞌALTETZ U JESUUS ITZꞌIBꞌA U TIO Unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla yol uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan taꞌn u Mateo tiꞌ u Jesús

content: Unqꞌa qꞌesla ibꞌaal u Jesucristo
U Jesucristo uvaꞌ tiaal David, as tiaal u Abrahameꞌ Aak unpajte. As ech vibꞌii unqꞌa qꞌesla ibꞌaal Aak ileꞌ:
As ikꞌaol Abraham u Isaac; ikꞌaol u Isaac u Jacob; ikꞌaol u Jacob u Judá tukꞌ unqꞌa titzꞌin tatzikeꞌ;
ikꞌaol u Judá u Fares tukꞌ u Zara. As Tamar ibꞌii vitxutxeꞌ. As ikꞌaol u Fares u Esrom ikꞌaol u Esrom u Aram;
ikꞌaol u Aram u Aminadab; ikꞌaol u Aminadab u Naasón; ikꞌaol u Naasón u Salmón;
ikꞌaol u Salmón u Booz. As itxutx u Booz u Rahab. Ikꞌaol u Booz u Obed. As itxutx u Obed u Rut. Ikꞌaol u Obed u Isaí;
ikꞌaol u Isaí u David uvaꞌ ok ijlenaalil. Ikꞌaol u David u Salomón. As itxutx u Salomón u ixoj uvaꞌ tixqelik u Urías.
Ikꞌaol u Salomón u Roboam; ikꞌaol u Roboam u Abías; ikꞌaol u Abías u Asa;
ikꞌaol u Asa u Josafat; ikꞌaol u Josafat u Joram; ikꞌaol u Joram u Uzías;
ikꞌaol u Uzías u Jotam; ikꞌaol u Jotam u Acaz; ikꞌaol u Acaz u Ezequías;
ikꞌaol u Ezequías u Manasés; ikꞌaol u Manasés u Amón; ikꞌaol u Amón u Josías.
As ech unbꞌiit teqꞌol bꞌen unqꞌa tiaal Israel preexhuil tu u Babilonia, as ikꞌaol veꞌt u Josías u Jeconías tukꞌ unqꞌa titzꞌineꞌ.
Tul maꞌtik ibꞌen veꞌt unqꞌa tiaal Israel preexhuil tu u Babilonia, as ikꞌaol veꞌt u Jeconías u Salatiel. As ikꞌaol u Salatiel u Zorobabel;
ikꞌaol u Zorobabel u Abiud; ikꞌaol u Abiud u Eliaquim; ikꞌaol u Eliaquim u Azor;
ikꞌaol u Azor u Sadoc; ikꞌaol u Sadoc u Aquim; ikꞌaol u Aquim u Eliud;
ikꞌaol u Eliud u Eleazar; ikꞌaol u Eleazar u Matán; ikꞌaol u Matán u Jacob;
ikꞌaol u Jacob u Xhuꞌl, vitzumel u Maꞌleꞌ. As aꞌ u Maꞌleꞌ vitxutx u Jesús uvaꞌ Cristo.

As kaalaval jolol unqꞌa tiaal u Abraham uveꞌ xeꞌtik tzan stiꞌ. As aꞌ ulkat tiꞌ u David. Kaalavat jolte uveꞌ xeꞌtik tzan tiꞌ u David. As aꞌ ulkat tul uvaꞌ sitxeypik bꞌen unqꞌa tiaal Israel preexhuil tu Babilonia. Kaalavat jolte tul siqꞌaavik veꞌt tzan unqꞌa tiaal Israel tu vitenameꞌ. As aꞌ ulkat tul uvaꞌ stitzꞌebꞌ u Cristo.
Ni titzꞌebꞌ u Jesús

Ech u titzꞌebꞌ u Jesucristo ileꞌ. Tul kꞌujlik veꞌt tzii tiꞌ u Maꞌleꞌ tukꞌ u Xhuꞌleꞌ tiꞌ uvaꞌ la teqꞌo tibꞌ chaꞌma as tul yeꞌxnik teqꞌot tibꞌ chaꞌma, as jeꞌ veꞌt ventasioon tiꞌ u Maꞌleꞌ, vitxutx u Jesúseꞌ, taꞌn u Tiixhla Espíritueꞌ.

As jikik chit itxumbꞌal u Xhuꞌleꞌ, vitzumel u Maꞌleꞌ, vatz u Tiixheꞌ. As yeꞌ nikat isaꞌ u Xhuꞌleꞌ teesal iqꞌii u Maꞌleꞌ vatz unqꞌa tenameꞌ. Tal veꞌt jeꞌ u Xhuꞌleꞌ ste uvaꞌ tu kuxh isuuchil la taqꞌ veꞌt kan u Xhuꞌleꞌ u Maꞌleꞌ.

Tul uvaꞌ nikat ibꞌan veꞌt jeꞌ u Xhuꞌleꞌ tiviꞌ, as ul tal veꞌt umaꞌl u ángel ste tivatzikꞌ. As ech tal u ángel ileꞌ: «Axh Xhuꞌl, tiaal David, yeꞌ kuxh xoꞌv axh tiꞌ eeqꞌot eebꞌ tukꞌ u Maꞌleꞌ, tan aꞌ u Tiixhla Espíritueꞌ kat ul aqꞌon kan ventasioon stiꞌ.
As la til veꞌt ixoj umaꞌl u neꞌ. As tul la itzꞌebꞌi, as Jesús ibꞌii u neꞌeꞌ la ebꞌaneꞌ, tan aꞌeꞌ la qꞌalpun vitenameꞌ vatz vipaaveꞌ,» tiꞌk u ángel tal te u Xhuꞌleꞌ.
As ech kat ibꞌan veꞌteꞌ echeꞌ uvaꞌ tal kan u Kubꞌaal Tiixheꞌ taꞌn u qꞌajsan tetz viyoleꞌ tul uvaꞌ ech tal Aak ileꞌ:

content.text: La jeꞌ ventasioon tiꞌ umaꞌl u qꞌopo ixoj.
As la til ixoj umaꞌl u neꞌ.
As tul la oksal ibꞌii u neꞌeꞌ, as Emanuel ibꞌii la ibꞌaneꞌ, tiꞌk viyol u Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ tal kan.

content: As aꞌ isuuchil u yoleꞌ uvaꞌ Emanuel tu kuyolbꞌal: Ateꞌ u Tiixheꞌ sqiꞌ.
Tul ul taama u Xhuꞌleꞌ taꞌn vivatzikꞌeꞌ, as inima veꞌt u Xhuꞌleꞌ kam uvaꞌ tal u ángel ste. As kꞌuxh teqꞌo veꞌt tibꞌ u Xhuꞌleꞌ tukꞌ u Maꞌleꞌ,
as yeꞌl u Xhuꞌleꞌ nikat ivat kꞌatz u Maꞌleꞌ. Pet itzꞌebꞌnal veꞌt u neꞌeꞌ. As tul itzꞌebꞌ u neꞌeꞌ, as Jesús ibꞌii u neꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ toksa veꞌt u Xhuꞌleꞌ.
